_comment: Blocks the plugin's tree-felling chain-break treats as tree trunk. The plugin resolves this tag through the server's tag registry at startup (falling back to config.yml's tree-felling.logs list if this datapack is not installed). Add any log/stem id here - no code changes needed. Ids that only exist in some game versions must use {"id": ..., "required": false}, or the whole tag is dropped on versions that lack them (pale oak arrived in 1.21.4, and this pack declares support back to pack_format 48).
